_meta.status: Exact transcription of every number/table on the page. Interval edge inclusivity (>= vs >) is NOT stated by the site: 'від X' is read as >= X, 'до X' as <= X for the upper lens thresholds and < X for score buckets; mark as Hypothesis until fitted on cards.
_meta.decimal_note: Site uses decimal comma; JSON uses dot.
_meta.flag_keys_source: DOM anchor ids flag-<key> on the methodology page (36 rows, same order as the table).

level.unknown_component_value: 40% of the component weight (also each sub-score has its own explicit 'unknown' points, see sub_scores)

hysteresis.previous_state_from: card computed by the same code version

level_E_regardless_of_score: SBC eats cash flow: >=100% of FCF (on OCF basis: SBC > 20% of revenue)
caps_in_order: moat determined by AI, not Taras: A -> B
profitable < 2 years: max C; < 5 years: max B
level A only with moat in {monopoly, oligopoly, network effect}
debt > 5x EBITDA with negative FCF, or capex funded by debt: max D (if the capex exception fails); > 3x with capex not from own cash: max C
growth built on customer promises: max C
level A with lowered guidance: B

one_off_tax_rule.trigger: effective tax rate differs > 10 pts vs prior 12M
one_off_tax_rule.action: EPS growth computed from normalised base: pre-tax income at company's usual rate = median of 8 quarterly rates; reported shown alongside; no quarterly taxes -> gap not assumption

level.one_fact_one_penalty: facts graded in a component (debt, dilution/SBC, margin squeeze, opex>revenue, AI risk) stay as labels without own penalty; critical flags keep penalty 8 + cap C

external_capex_financing.trigger: debt + share issuance > 25% of capex over 12M in capex-heavy company, or capex > 50% of OCF

level.margin_definition: smaller of (net margin, normalised where data allow) and (operating margin after tax); tax unknown: statutory 21% for SEC filers with a note, else second definition skipped; if consensus is non-GAAP also compute NTM P/E with options; S&P lens and PEG use the more expensive of the two

discipline (max 5).if: organic growth, capex covered by OCF
mixed growth, capex covered by OCF
growth via acquisitions, capex covered by OCF
growth unknown, capex covered by OCF
organic, no capex numbers, funded from operating cash
organic, no capex numbers, funding unknown
organic, no capex numbers, funded by debt
organic, debt+issuance >25% of capex, net cash>0 and debt<=1.5x EBITDA (can pay)
same, net cash negative or debt>1.5x EBITDA (lands on balance sheet; cap B)

components.growth_component_composition: revenue + EPS + FCF sub-scores (max 8+7+5 = 20); site note on revenue table: 'contribution of revenue; the rest of growth in the probe is negative'
components.table_method_note: Site: 'points below were computed by the engine itself on one company with full data, changing one field at a time' -> these are measured steps, not literal config

price.basis: from registry (P/E, P/FCF or P/OCF); if absent the engine picks and states why; P/OCF forbidden when FCF negative and capex not covered by own cash

scores.note: only levels A and B, else 0

rules.if: EPS growth >= 1.5 x index EPS growth
EPS growth < 0.9 x index EPS growth

price_word_rules_in_order: no multiple -> NO_MULTIPLE ('Немає мультиплікатора') -> verdict NEED_DATA
multiple <= 15 and quality score < 60 and EPS growth < 10% -> VALUE_TRAP ('Пастка дешевизни')
else EPS growth >= 15% (level A: 14%) -> EXPENSIVE_GROWING ('Дорого, але росте'), otherwise EXPENSIVE_NO_GROWTH ('Дорого без росту')
EXPENSIVE_NO_GROWTH only if base 5y CAGR < BUY bar (14% for A, 15% others); otherwise EXPENSIVE_GROWING with a note on growth two years ahead

regime_2026.bonus: +1 to lens SUM if multiple <= 20 and level in {A,B}

price.one_eps_growth_per_card: geometric mean of two steps: (NTM vs normalised trailing 12M base) and (next year vs that NTM); only one known step -> use it; used for growth score, PEG, price word, lenses; both steps + mean shown on card

cycle_peak.effects: row under verdict + Known risks; NOT a flag; PEG lens capped at +1
cycle_peak.loss_to_profit_turnaround: NEW 2026-10-03: loss->profit within 12M is marked the same way and does not enter verdict or lenses

before_matrix: gate 0: stop-list -> NOT_MINE (+ shadow verdict), 'not understood' -> AVOID, speculative basket -> SPEC_ONLY
broken thesis (lowered guidance, growth without profit, analysts cutting forecasts) -> BUY WAIT for A/B/C, AVOID for D/E
matrix.special_cell: level A with PEG < 0.5 -> BUY regardless of price word and lens sum; never STRONG BUY
one_event_one_flag: EPS consensus revision 30d/90d = one flag, severity depends on consensus source
capex > OCF and negative FCF = one inequality, one penalty
negative-FCF-quarters series critical only if 12M FCF negative or >=4 quarters; shorter series with positive FCF = minor (seasonality)

after_matrix.critical_flag: no STRONG BUY / BUY -> BUY WAIT for A/B/C else AVOID

x2_arithmetic.growth_per_year: consensus then decay, max 25% decay per step
x2_arithmetic.optimistic: multiple back to mean; shown, not in verdict

after_matrix.data_trust: no NTM EPS forecast, no current multiple, or no basis -> NEED_DATA, card names fields
after_matrix.not_reviewed_or_ai_classified: level <= B, verdict <= BUY with card label; no classification: position <= tracking size 1%
after_matrix.position_caps: none > 10% of portfolio; STRONG BUY level A up to 15%; NEW: 'mega-cap also not higher' (than 15%); one sub-sector <= 30% total; reader advice, not Taras's portfolio rules

verdict_definitions.STRONG_BUY: buy: good company (A/B) at cheap price, x2 passes the bar, no critical flags, Taras reviewed
verdict_definitions.BUY: buy: fair price for a good company, or cheap for level C, or a STRONG BUY lowered by arithmetic or incomplete data
verdict_definitions.BUY_WAIT: want to buy, not now: expensive but growing; or critical flag; or arithmetic short. Card names entry price
verdict_definitions.AVOID: do not buy: weak company (level E), broken thesis or value trap
verdict_definitions.SPEC_ONLY: speculation only: speculative basket behind gate 0 or cheap level D; position <= tracking size
verdict_definitions.NEED_DATA: data missing: no EPS forecast, current multiple or basis; card names fields
verdict_definitions.NOT_MINE: not my sector: stop-list basket, analysis done fully, shadow verdict shown

flags.concentration_rule: serious when one customer >= 25% of revenue or top-2 together >= 33%; critical when one >= 40%; a single flag; shares from annual report; customer groups only in Known risks
